## Summary

What this change does and why.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation

## Checklist

- [ ] `tests\Invoke-Tests.ps1` passes on Windows (paste the summary below).
- [ ] New behaviour has a Pester test.
- [ ] Windows PowerShell 5.1 compatibility is preserved, or the PR explains why not.
- [ ] Settings and session schemas are unchanged, or a migration is included.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` and the relevant `docs/` page are updated.
- [ ] No API keys, credential files, session exports or logs are included.

(test summary)

## Notes for the reviewer

Anything that touches budgeting, credentials, logging or provider requests, and
anything you were unsure about.
